metadata.short_desc: Track text-call token usage, timing and estimated costs by plugin and model.
metadata.desc: Summarizes text-model calls, token usage and estimated cost by source plugin and model, with trends, rankings and optional call details. Collection is off by default and covers calls made through AstrBot text-provider methods in the current process. Use /usage for summaries or the Web page to manage collection, prices and retention. Data stays in the host plugin-data directory; no message bodies or API keys are stored. Optional text logs include session identifiers.

enabled.hint: Records text-model calls in the current process. Turning it off preserves existing statistics.

memory_cap.hint: Attempts to save when exceeded. Clears the call buffer on success; retains pending calls on failure and may exceed the threshold. 0 disables the threshold.

keep_days.hint: Prunes daily totals and call details outside the retention window. 0 disables age-based pruning.

save_every.hint: Attempts to save daily totals after this many calls. 0 disables this trigger; regular /usage queries, unloading and the memory threshold can still trigger a save.

refresh_interval.hint: Discovers providers loaded later and flushes pending logs and details. Measured in seconds; 0 disables this periodic task.

call_log.hint: Writes usage, request-component lengths, timing and session identifiers to calls.log, without message bodies. Redact before sharing.

call_log_lines.hint: Trims the file to this target after it exceeds twice the target. 0 disables trimming; the page read limit remains.

detail_history.hint: Requires usage collection. Stores time, source, model, result, usage and timing, without session identifiers, message bodies or keys. Details cannot be reconstructed for calls made before it was enabled.

detail_max_events.hint: Range 1-200000. Prunes stored details after daily totals commit; recovery rows may exceed the target. The pending queue drops its oldest unwritten details at this hard limit and reports it.

debug.hint: Writes source, model, session identifiers, image count, request-component lengths and timing to the AstrBot log, without message bodies. Use the call log for a separate file.
